In Manufacturing & Industrial, agentic ai & hyperautomation turns knowledge work into orchestrated autonomy. That is the baseline pattern; the differentiator is what it connects to: agentic process automation, digital workforce & multi-agent orchestration, decision intelligence systems — delivered on KYC Management System and EEMS Platform and Driisti Smart Vision Glasses with the sector's regulatory posture built in.

items: Planning by spreadsheet under volatility

Planners fight demand volatility, material shortages and changeovers in spreadsheets; scheduling knowledge lives in two veterans' heads. OEE losses from changeover and waiting are structurally accepted.
Maintenance planning reactive
PM schedules fire by calendar while failures happen by physics; planners cannot see which assets are trending toward failure this week.
Brownfield instrumentation gap
Critical assets run uninstrumented because gut-and-replace is unthinkable; the data that twins and models need does not exist, and downtime for retrofit is unaffordable.

blocks.x: How we deliver it in this sector

The delivery pattern composes 7 services from the Agentic AI & Hyperautomation tower — Agentic Process Automation, Digital Workforce & Multi-Agent Orchestration, Decision Intelligence Systems, Intelligent Document Processing as the usual core — sequenced through the Achala Method with sector controls: NIS2 (EU operators) obligations shape the design from the first sprint.
